avis.texte: I originally ordered the Tirtir Ceramic Ampoule, but since I don’t have Prime right now, I added this toner to qualify for free shipping. Unfortunately, the ampoule arrived opened. It honestly looked like it had already been used and returned by someone else, so I had to send it back. I decided to keep the toner though—and I’m actually really glad I did. My skin tends to be on the oily side, and this toner works great for me. It doesn’t dry out my skin, but it also doesn’t make it greasy. It feels very lightweight and basically disappears on the face. I personally prefer a matte finish, and I’m honestly tired of everything being about “glass skin” these days. So for me, this was a lucky find. That said, Amazon really needs to do better with quality control. This is the third time in a year that I’ve received used skincare products, and it’s getting frustrating.

avis.titre: Nothing special. No help with redness.
avis.texte: Mediocre at best. Didn’t help with my redness and does not help with skin hydration. The regular tirtir rice toner is better.

This toner feels very gentle and refreshing on the skin. The texture is lightweight and watery, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky or heavy residue. It provides a nice calming effect, especially when my skin feels irritated or sensitive. I like that it adds hydration without feeling greasy, and it layers well with serums and moisturizers. The matcha element feels soothing, and my skin looks more balanced after use. There’s little to no noticeable scent, which I appreciate. I’m giving it 4 stars because the results are subtle and gradual rather than dramatic, but it’s a solid everyday toner for sensitive or combination skin. I would repurchase, especially for calming and hydration.

I love this stuff, it makes my skin look amazing! I've tried their regular version as well and I think this one is more moistrizing! I will say I do like the original lotion better than the matcha one because it doesn't have the texture of moisturizer.
Feels great, not too sticky, very hydrating and works great on my sensitive, red-prone skin.
10/10 - my skin loves this one! Usually I use the Light regular toner, but this will now be my go to. Leaves my skin buttery soft

avis.titre: Calming and refreshing to the skin!
avis.texte: Best skin toner ever! It calms my skin and refreshes it all at once :) I LOVE tirtir’s products!!!

Lovely toner, I came across this by accident when I received a free sample from Boots. I loved it so much I found it on Amazon and bought the full size. It's a bit pricey but I like the look and feel of my skin after use.

avis.titre: My acne skin improving a lot, less redness and more brighter
avis.texte: I have an acne-prone skin. This product makes my skin brighter, but not to be dry, oily at all. My skin looks really refreshing and smooth. My redness is also improving a lot. I use this one together with Matcha Serum. They both works well on my skin.

avis.titre: Milk is soy milk and leaves no residue
avis.texte: This product was launched in September 2025. I believe the 8/25 expiration date on the bottom is the date of manufacture and it's a misprint. I was pretty excited to try a matcha toner. Green tea is so soothing and can be used as a face wash so I don't know why matcha isn't more common in beauty products. I would consider Tirtir a trusted brand as they have a lot of high quality, popular beauty products. If you wanted to try out a matcha beauty product this would be a good choice. Pros: -Plant based: I am not sure if the lactobacillus ferment is vegan but most of the ingredients are. The milk is from soy milk and the PDRN is from matcha. A lot of PDRN is from salmon emissions which gives me an ick as a vegetarian. -No residue: I was worried the milkiness would leave a residue but it does not. Once it dries down this toner is fine under sunscreen or makeup. -Effects: It was mild, refreshing and soothed redness as claimed. I am trying to get away from acids and the ph seemed neutral as claimed. -Presentation: The bottle is frosted glass not plastic and had a large quantity. -Ingredients: There is a clear ingredients list which contains numerous plant extracts. Glycerin is the primary ingredient which is usually mild. It is more of a water based product than oil based. I am still getting used to Korean skincare where toning is an important step and lots of plant extracts are used. That is different than American toners which are simple. I appreciate that it isn't straight witch

As a longtime fan of the TIRTIR brand, I was so excited to order this Matcha Skin Toner! The toner arrived in a beautiful glass bottle, with 5.07 fl oz of product–enough to last for months, even when applied liberally. The toner is lightweight and milky, and doesn't leave any oily residue or sticky feeling on the skin once applied. My skin feels hydrated and ready for moisturizer and sunscreen after applying. I have combination skin, but I believe that this toner could be used by any skin type as its ingredients are universally beneficial. I've used multiple PDRN products in the past, but have never tried Matcha PDRN. This TIRTIR toner is infused with 10,000 ppm Matcha-PDRN and a Soymilk Complex, providing deep nourishment and moisture balance. The toner has a pH 6.0 skin-friendly formula maintains balance and strengthens skin barrier for daily use, and I've found it incredibly useful in repairing my skin barrier from retinol use. It also contains Soymilk Complex, Lactobacillus Ferment, and SYDENY RINGER, and all of which provide additional moisture and hydration while supporting overall skin health. Overall, this toner is a great addition to my skincare lineup and I've found that it really does provide long-lasting hydration. I'm excited to keep using it and will check in with updates on my skin once I've been using it for a few weeks!

avis.titre: Effectively alleviates redness and makes my skin look toned and even.
avis.texte: I'd never before tested TIRTIR products, but I really like this Matcha Skin Toner. The texture is lightweight and it absorbs quickly, without feeling too sticky or heavy. I tend to get some redness around my laugh lines and nose, but I've noticed an observable reduction in redness after using this daily for a couple of weeks. My skin tone does look more even and less blotchy overall. I appreciate that it’s formulated with Matcha and Centella, both of which are known for their soothing properties. It's gentle on my sensitive skin and I haven't experienced any issues with discomfort or irritation. It layers well under both serum and moisturizer, and I have found that I don't need to use a makeup toner whenever I use this skin toner in my moisturizing routine. It actually preps my skin for makeup in the same way that my makeup toner does, so that was a welcome discovery. Overall, I'm highly impressed with this Matcha skin toner, as it effectively calms redness while keeping my skin soft and balanced. It's a bit pricey at $25.00, but this is quite a large sized bottle, with a lot of product. Very little is required for each application, so I expect this bottle to last quite awhile. I am highly likely to purchase again, and absolutely recommend.

I like this more than I thought I would. I have sensitive skin that turns red every time I wash my face. It's not an irritation to my skincare, I'm not aggressively scrubbing, and my water isn't too hot, turning red is just something or does and it normally takes a while for it to level out. I've found that if I use this toner after washing my face, it does seem to calm down the redness quicker than anything else I've v tried. It definitely has something in it that is calming to my skin. I have combination skin that is acneprone and it works well for both issues. It does help with moisturizing without feeling heavy, oily, or drying and I haven't had any issues with my skin purging or additional breakouts from this toner. This has a green color but doesn't have a scent that I can detect. While green is what I would use as a color corrector, this does not color correct. If you are looking for something that will recolor your skin tone, you won't be happy with your product. For me at least, the redness control comes down to calming down the skin vs. changing undertones.

I am a 46 year old woman with dry skin who also loves Korean skincare and toners. I’ve always been curious at TirTir products and was excited to order and try their Matcha Skin Toner. This toner arrived well sealed in a really nice, glass, 5.07 bottle. It utilizes a dropper hold tip, making it easy to shake a few drops into my hand. It’s a milky green color and thin, watery consistency. This toner includes great ingredients; a very hefty dose of matcha PDRN, soy milk and centella. I know that Centella is great for redness, which I don’t have a concern with but appreciate that it’s a gentle ingredient. It also boasts improving the skin barrier and cooling. It also contains Sydney Ringer, a proprietary ingredient focused on hydration. With a 6.0 pH score, this is a nicely balanced toner. It includes micro dipping technology, which is designed to help the toner absorb better and more quickly. I sprinkled a few drops in my had and patted the toner into my skin. The milky green color did not show on my skin. As far as absorption goes, it absorbs fine, but did not feel accelerated compared to many other toners that I have tried. I use the 7 skin method of layering toners and found that this layered well after waiting a few minutes for absorption between applications. Once absorbed, it felt lightweight and left no residue to worry about. Once dry and absorbed, I could feel and see positive effects with hydration in my face, but I’d rate it an average hydration experience. I could fe

For starters, I have fairly normal skin. I like this toner in terms of how it feels on my skin and the hydration it seems to provide. I cannot say whether it’s really helped with my redness as I haven’t noticed a difference after using it for 2 weeks, but I did develop several acne spots after use when my skin was clear prior to testing this product…. I would go easy on it and not apply too much as you will still be able to see the tint of the toner. It goes on smoothly though and is absorbed easily by the skin. This product is NOT silicone free and it is also not vegan or fungal acne safe. Taking a look at the ingredients and doing your research, this product is recommend for relieving redness but it also contains sodium chloride which is known to be a trigger for rosacea as well as having a higher likelihood of clogging pores and triggering breakouts.

This was my first experience with TirTir brand skincare and I am so glad I gave it a shot! This toner feels like a luxurious addition to my skincare routine. It comes in a sleek frosted glass bottle with a fairly narrow opening on the top for the toner to be poured out. This is nice because you can shake it out drop by drop and you only need around 4-5 drops to cover your face. I expect this bottle to last me quite a while. I have acne prone combination skin and this toner has been great for me on two levels: 1) it has not broken me out and is non irritating, and 2) it is really hydrating despite how light it is. I’m not sure that I see a huge amount of redness reduction, but that could just be due to my skin type (I already have a lot of green undertones in my olive skin). I appreciate the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties of the Matcha regardless. I will definitely be trying other TirTir products going forward.

avis.titre: The Day My Face Stopped Looking Like a Tomato
avis.texte: I’ll admit it: I bought this toner out of desperation. My skin had been throwing tantrums for weeks—red, blotchy, and basically glowing like a stop sign. I figured, worst case, I’d just smell like a cup of matcha tea. The first time I tried it, I poured a little onto a cotton pad and swiped it on. Within a couple of minutes, my face felt calmer, less tight, and definitely less fire-engine red. I even caught myself in the mirror and thought, Hey, that looks almost like normal skin. Here’s the short story: The other night, my husband asked if I’d finally “given up on skincare experiments” because my face looked so much better. I didn’t have the heart to tell him I’d just started another one—with this toner. I just smiled and said, “Yep, keeping it simple now.” (Meanwhile, I was already planning to add the matching cream to my cart.) If your skin throws fits like mine, this matcha toner feels like a chill best friend that tells your skin to calm down. Definitely a keeper.

avis.titre: I love this Matcha Skin Toner
avis.texte: This is the first time I am trying out a Matcha skin toner and I love it. It is interesting because it is colored green, the texture is watery, it gets easily absorbed by my skin and very easy to apply using my palm. The bottle is pretty decently sized, I am really happy by its volume. My product came in with an expiry date of 2028 so it can gifted to someone, or has long life for personal use. This product is not greasy, does not leave residue, and it doesn't irritate my skin. It is very nice to use when I am stressed out as it can calm my skin. This product doesn't seem to have any kind of scent, which I must admit, didn't expect. The product is nicely packaged, the bottle looks and feels premium. Overall, I love it!

avis.titre: Someone is skimping on the matcha
avis.texte: UHMMMM!?!?!? HELLO!!! I’m never usually a stickler for these things but I’ve loved the milk toner from TirTir so as soon as I heard about this matcha one I was like YESSSS sign me up but.. do y’all see this.. I brought stuff to the bathroom for my nightly cleansing routine ready to try this for the first time and why does it look like someone used like a weeks worth of it or more. Did anyone else get a bottle that wasn’t fully filled because the seal thingy is intact and hasn’t been messed with because the top is super clean. I’m a bit upset because my milk toner is beloved and hardly has a bigger dent than this and this product is unused so far so what the heck. I understand not everything needs to touch the top with bottles but can we at least make the mark closer than this one because this is a gap of product just missing.

What’s included: 1 TIRTIR Matcha Skin Toner This toner is really lightweight, it absorbs fast, leaving my skin feeling soft and refreshed. The mix of niacinamide, matcha, and centella makes it a nice blend of brightening and calming ingredients. The only thing I’m not a big fan of is the mentha (peppermint). It’s basically just added fragrance with a little cooling effect, and it doesn’t really do much for the skin. Pros • Light and quick absorbing • Hydrating and soothing • Niacinamide and matcha combo is great for brightening Cons • Mentha extract is basically unnecessary fragrance Uniqueness: Feels like a toner and essence in one, with a nice balance of hydration and antioxidants. Worth It or Not: Worth it if you want a hydrating toner with extra brightening and calming benefits.

avis.titre: My skin's daily dose of 'tea-riffic' matcha goodness
avis.texte: I have a matcha face wash that I love so 'matcha', thus I was looking forward to trying a matcha toner. This toner is quite nice. It comes in a glass container and it leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. Definitely a non-sticky formula and is gentle, it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped yet not overly moisturized, greasy or filmy. Well balanced toner indeed and no irritation. Do note, the liquid is very green and it will stain anything white. My washable toner pads are white, well, one of them now has a faint green stain on it because I just fell into my routine with my first use of this toner. Since I really do not want stained reusable cotton rounds I now use small cotton balls with this.

Feels super fancy at a great price! I was not expecting a glass bottle when this came. You get a luxury experience with this. The bottle is large and its going to last you for several months as well. The toner works really well and is super lightweight on your skin. It does help to reduce redness and irritation. I have noticed an improvement in my skin and imperfections. I do think it has a very subtle scent that I'm not super found of, but its so subtle you can hardly notice it and sometimes I dont even notice. The toner is green but once you apply it, it doesn't make your skin green so no worries. Overall a fantastic product and a great value for what you are receiving.

In my opinion, this Jeju Matcha-PDRN toner is a gentle and effective way to calm redness and balance her skin tone. I like how the 10,000 ppm PDRN infusion feels soothing, leaving her skin refreshed and comfortable after each use. The micro-immersion technology really seems to help with fast absorption, so it doesn’t feel sticky or heavy. For me, what makes it stand out is the thoughtful formulation. The soy milk and centella complex adds just the right touch of hydration while supporting healthy skin, and the pH 6.0 makes it gentle enough for daily use on all skin types. She enjoys pairing it with the matcha cream for a complete routine, and it truly helps her skin look calm, even, and radiant.

avis.titre: A latte toner? Somehow, yes. I love!
avis.texte: This toner looks just like a matcha latte, which is weird but I kind of like it. It didn't react poorly with my skin and seems to be hydrating and helping even out my redness. I didn't have many skin concerns, just wanted to keep my skin hydrated and clear. There is a lot in the bottle, so it will last a long while. The scent is very mild, something else I appreciate. I will use this every night and morning after washing and under the rest of my skincare.

This review is for TIRTIR Matcha Skin Toner, which is made in Korea. The toner is green and has a very light, almost unnoticeable earthy scent that I actually enjoy. The toner hydrates by adding moisture to the skin but this one also leaves a light sheen that indicates it is moisturizing as well by providing a seal that keeps the hydration in. At a price of $25.00 for 5.07 oz, I think this is a pretty good value for the money. I did not experience any irritation when using the product and you can see the ingredient list in the final image.

I love this TIRTIR Matcha Toner! If you struggle with redness or just need a daily boost of hydration, this Korean facial toner is an excellent choice. It is designed specifically for red or irritated skin. It uses Jeju Matcha-PDRN (10,000ppm), a key ingredient that works to calm redness and promote a more even skin tone. Since it features a pH of 6.0, which is close to the skin's natural acidic level, it supports balancing and is generally very light, refreshing, and non-irritating, making it suitable for sensitive and all skin types. The texture is great because it utilizes innovative micro dipping technology which means it absorbs very quickly into the skin, delivering instant hydrating and soothing care. It feels great on the skin, has a subtle, pleasant fragrance, and comes in a large quantity, so it's easy to use daily. Beyond the matcha, the formula has a gentle blend of soymilk and centella complexes. This combo provides soothing moisture while supporting healthy, clear looking skin. If you're looking for a soothing, balancing toner that absorbs fast and helps calm your skin, this is an excellent product at a fair price.

avis.titre: TIRTIR Matcha Skin Toner- Works well for redness
avis.texte: This comes in a large and heavy glass bottle that makes my other containers look cheap. I can put some in my palm and pat my face and despite the low consistency, it doesn't run right off. I guess my skin needs the help because it soaks it right up. I have pale skin that turns pink very easily and have found that it works wonderfully right after i get out of the shower. I haven't really noticed a difference with toner before, but this one has been a little different.

This toner is surprisingly lightweight and watery but it is good as it doesn't leave a sticky residue on my face. It does have a green matcha hue but it doesn't tint your skin green at all. I applied it to my face after cleansing and it felt refreshing and cooling. I didn't experience any irritation or redness while using this toner. It also leaves my face fully hydrated and I top it off with their corresponding moisturizer to lock in the hydration. This toner is a really great value, the bottle is big and I only needed to use a few drops on each sides of my face.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel fresh, very soothing
avis.texte: I haven’t been an avid toner user, most make my face feel dry and tight after using. I saw this was a matcha toner and thought it would be worth a try. I’m SO glad I did!! This stuff is incredible. It is green, like matcha, but it doesn’t turn your skin green when you apply it. It does leave your skin fresh and hydrated though! It’s very soothing and rich, yet doesn’t leave a film or cakey feeling after applying. It comes in a huge bottle, this will last a long time. I only apply a small amount to my cotton ball and I’m able to do my whole face. Great value!! After using for a just a couple days my skin looks brighter, my pores seem smaller and my skin appears to have a slight glow. This is way more than I expected! I’m sold on using a toner from now on, as long as it’s THIS toner!!
